headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for LED strips controlled by WLED
footerDisplay: For a detailed description, see the [README](https://github.com/smhex/homebridge-wled-ws#readme) file.

name.title: Plugin Platform Name
name.description: This name is only visible in the Homebridge logs.

name.title: Name
name.description: This name is used as accessory name in Homekit

presets.title: List of presets
presets.description: Enter a list of comma separated presets

showRealTimeModeButton.title: Realtime Mode Button
showRealTimeModeButton.description: If enabled, an additional button will be added in homebridge.

resetRealTimeModeAfterStream.title: Reset Realtime Mode After Stream
resetRealTimeModeAfterStream.description: If enabled, realtime mode will be enabled again, after the current session is closed.

enableMatter.title: Matter
enableMatter.description: If enabled, the controllers are additionally exposed as Matter lights. Requires Homebridge 2 with Matter enabled for this bridge. If the bridge is also paired via HomeKit, the lights appear twice in the Home app.

testController.title: Test controller
testController.description: If enabled, a simulated WLED controller "WLED Test" with the presets "Test Red" and "Test Blue" is added (on/off, brightness, color). Use it to test the connection to HomeKit / Matter without hardware. Its state is reset when Homebridge restarts.

testControllerPort.title: Test controller port
testControllerPort.description: Local port (127.0.0.1) of the simulated controller. Change it only if the port is in use.

logging.title: Logging
logging.description: If enabled, additional log messages will be printed to the Homebridge log. This is useful for debugging purposes, but may also lead to a lot of log messages.

form.title: Advanced Settings
form.description: Don't change these, unless you understand what you're doing.
